programmes.d: The guys drag a classic Chevy out of a hay barn and restore it to its former glory.
Pat and Mike button up their Hemi with super trick heads; tech tips.
Tommy and Joel roll a Hurst Olds into the shop and begin adding thunder back into this classic.
Restoring an '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket's finish to a showroom shine.
Grease and gears begin to fly as we swap out our 307 engine for one built in shop of Joe Mondello.
Taking the Hurst's performance from worst to first.
Tommy and Joel visit a museum in a Lane of its own to see some one-of-a-kind vehicles.
Pat & Frankie machine a beastly Small Block Ford for serious pump-gas track power.
Dyno Day! We assemble our 363 SBF beast and reveal the project it was built for.
Turning a junkyard Ford flathead into a classic hot rod V8; prepping the block to handle a stroked rotating assembly.
Automotive specialist, Keith Dorton, helps build a Ford flathead with 3/4 race cam, high compression heads and 3 deuces.
We build a 427ci pump-gas LSx for a Music City Trucks C10, aiming for hot rod power.
The 427-ci LSx engine for Music City Trucks' C10 is being completed with EFI and dyno-tuning.
We're twin-turboing our 600+ HP 427ci Small Block Chevy with new EFI, pushing Baby Blue to the limit!
Transforming everyday cars into road burners.
Time for the ultimate payoff of the Budget Jeep and Alloy Jeep.
Transforming a '70 Monte Carlo into a G-Machine for a contest.
Muscle Car gets a hand from Horsepower Mike in stiffening the frame on the Monte Carlo G-Machine.
MuscleCar demonstrates how to get rid of a gnarly old Vinyl Top on the Monte Carlo G-Machine.
It's time for the finishing touches on the Monte Carlo G-Machine.
Ford versus Chevy.

Bowtie boy Ryan's got a big play for using big displacement to make big power for his entry; Kevin's not allowed in the shop as Ryan's adding new heads, a new valve train, a pro-flo EFI throttle body.
Turbocharging a V-8.
A suspension overhaul in the 1994 Ford Lightning.
After his 1990 Chevy 454 SS, with its own lowering kit, new brakes, wheels and tires, gets dropped into the weeds, Ryan returns fire.
A chassis dyno shootout; Nashville Good Guys show.
Scoring the Ford and the Chevy on performance to road manner.
The guys drag a Chevy out of a barn; using rubberized coating to build furniture out of an old engine.
The guys install a plethora of new body panels on the Chevelle.
The Detroit Muscle Crew upgrades the suspension on a classic Chevelle for high-end handling.
Fitting panels on a classic Chevelle; repairing cracked or broken fiberglass.
A frame-off Chevelle Barn restoration continues with a metallic baby blue paint job, with tips on using a spray gun.
The team installs a brand-new interior in their 1972 Chevelle project, including all the wiring and trim.
Marc and Tommy work on getting the 1972 Chevelle Supercharger Intercooler plumbed for a 1000 horsepower small block, and learn how to cut a run out of clear coat.
The 1972 Chevelle barn find project needs a fuel system to support the 1,000-horsepower engine and an exhaust system to let it exhale.
The guys finish up the barn find Chevelle and take it to a famous road in the Smoky Mountains, finding a movie car museum along the way.
